descriptionChirho: Comparative adjective/adverb indicating temporal priority, referring to what came before in time, whether used adverbially ('formerly, before, at first') or adjectivally ('former lusts, former days'). The semantic core is identical: temporal anteriority. Rendered: Spanish 'anteriormente/antes/anterior/primero', Hindi 'pahle/pehle' (पहले), Arabic 'awwalan/saabiqan/saabiqa' (أَوَّلًا/سابِقًا/سَابِقَة), Korean 'ijeon-e/jeonui/cheoeum' (이전에/전의/처음), Swahili 'kwanza/zamani/za awali/mara ya kwanza'. All three clusters share the same root semantic of temporal precedence with only grammatical variation.
